description.narrative: BactiVac is a global bacterial vaccinology network bringing together members based in academic, industry and policy sectors to accelerate the development of vaccines against bacterial infections relevant to low and middle-income countries (LMICs). The BactiVac Network delivers this through catalyst project and training awards to encourage cross-collaboration between academic and industrial partners in developed and developing nations.
